correctness.rationale: From the incidence basis x_i=e_{u,v_i}, y_i=e_{v_i,w}, z=e_{u,w}, the sole nonzero products are x_i y_i=z, so squares span kz and give hyperbolic quadratic form q(x,y)=x^T y. A bijective square-preserver must fix the square-span line up to multiplier and induce q-similitude on A/kz; its shear is arbitrary. Associative product preservation forces coordinate block diagonal M=diag(P,cP^{-T}). Linearization of D(a²)=D(a)a+aD(a) produces S=λI−P^T and alternating off-diagonal Q,R with zero diagonals even in characteristic two; ordered derivation identity forces Q=R=0. Dimension counts then follow. Hyperbolic bases count O^+(2r,q) recursively by S_r=(q^{r−1}+1)(q^r−1) isotropic nonzero first vectors and q^{2r−2} mates; multiplier surjectivity and central shears give both group orders and index. Independently generated linear constraints (not using supplied normal-form checker) returned ordinary/Jordan dimensions (r+1)^2,2r²+r+1 for r=1..4 over F_2 and F_3, including zero-diagonal char-2 restrictions. These checks corroborate the all-field proof.
